question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s consolidated control over the Chinese Communist Party, Central Military Commission, and state presidency underpins the 95.9% trader consensus against removal before 2027. Ongoing military and party purges, personnel appointments favoring loyalists, and routine public appearances through mid-2026 have shown no elite fractures or health signals that would prompt abrupt change ahead of the 21st Party Congress. Leadership transitions in China have historically aligned with scheduled congresses rather than sudden ousters, and no factional opposition or policy reversal has materialized. Low-probability shifts remain possible from an unforeseen medical event, severe economic downturn eroding internal support, or external crisis that fractures elite cohesion before December 2026.
